# Full LLM & AI Knowledge Specification: CKM Catering (ចេង គួងម៉េង)

## Brand Identity & History
- **Brand Name**: CKM Catering / ចេង គួងម៉េង / 鍾光明餐飲
- **Canonical Domain**: https://ckmkh.com
- **Founded & Heritage**: Over 60 years of culinary leadership in Phnom Penh, Cambodia.
- **Cuisine Specialization**: Sino-Khmer Fusion Banquet Cuisine, Authentic Traditional Khmer Royal Banquet Dishes, Chinese Banquet Classics.

## Detailed Service Catalog

### 1. Wedding Banquet Catering (សេវាកម្មម្ហូបការ)
- Traditional 8-course banquet menus tailored for Cambodian weddings.
- On-site master chef supervision ensuring food temperature, freshness, and food safety standards.
- Full venue setup including tables, chairs, luxury table linens, fine china, and dedicated waitstaff.

### 2. Housewarming & Private Events (សេវាកម្ម Catering ពិធីឡើងផ្ទះ)
- Specialized banquet options for home inauguration and family celebrations in Phnom Penh.
- Customizable menu selection with food tasting sessions prior to event confirmation.

### 3. Corporate Galas & Public Events (សេវាកម្ម Catering ក្រុមហ៊ុន)
- High-end corporate buffets, cocktail parties, and VIP gala dinners for domestic and international organizations in Cambodia.
- On-site mobile kitchen setup capable of serving 500+ guests simultaneously.

### 4. Tent & Outdoor Infrastructure (រៀបចំរោងការ និងតុអាហារ)
- Premium outdoor rainproof and climate-controlled banquet tents.
- Professional lighting, stage setup, and table layout planning.

## Quality & Hygiene Standards
- Strictly monitored cold-chain storage and fresh daily market sourcing in Phnom Penh.
- Uniformed, trained service personnel adhering to high hospitality standards.
